summary: The candidate is a verified partial fix for ordinary TP constrained decoding: a non-entry rank skips grammar lookup and carries a placeholder, the entry token is broadcast for constrained batches, and unconstrained batches retain the no-extra-collective path. It intentionally disables this optimization for speculative decoding and active attention context parallelism, so it does not fully resolve the original TP feature request.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before behavior: a simulated non-entry TP rank submitted one grammar backend lookup and retained a Future.

Passing-after ordinary TP behavior (zero lookup and PlaceholderGrammarObject) and remaining adversarial source paths: speculative TP and CP-active TP each made one backend lookup and retained a Future.
Candidate regression and compatibility coverage: 97 passed, including placeholder compilation avoidance, constrained broadcast, legacy fallback, and no collective for unconstrained batches.
All candidate-changed Python implementation modules compiled successfully.

tests.command: inline Torch ROCm masked-argmax comparison recorded in raw/evidence.txt
tests.what_was_measured: On one MI350X, masked argmax [2, 3] matched an independently computed allowed-token reference [2, 3]; this is not distributed-serving evidence.

gpu_execution.evidence: Torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2 executed an independent mask numerical check on one AMD Instinct MI350X. Only one GPU was visible, so no true TP/CP distributed execution was possible.

remaining_counterexamples: With tensor parallelism and speculative decoding active, tp_grammar_entry_only is false; a non-entry TP rank still submits a grammar backend lookup and retains per-rank grammar masking/state.
With tensor parallelism and an active attention context-parallel group, tp_grammar_entry_only is false; applicable non-entry ranks still compile grammars and apply masks.
remaining_limitations: Speculative TP needs a correctness design that synchronizes draft/verify-tree grammar masks, FSM advancement, accepted lengths/indexes, and committed tokens; ordinary sampler token broadcast alone does not establish that contract.
Attention context parallelism needs ownership and collectives across its orthogonal CP/TP request topology; the candidate deliberately retains the legacy path.
Exactly one GPU was available, preventing real multi-rank TP, speculative TP, attention context-parallel TP, distributed serving, and end-to-end overhead measurement.
The deterministic tiny Llama fixture cannot qualify the unavailable distributed architectures and was not used as substitute proof.
No native sources changed, so a native rebuild was not applicable.
